people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
translations.bsb: “I never expected to see your face again,” Israel said to Joseph, “but now God has let me see your children as well.”
translations.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
translations.asv: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath let me see thy seed also.
